title: HPC-R1: Characterizing R1-like Large Reasoning Models on HPC
problem: Limited understanding of Large Reasoning Model (LRM) training performance and system inefficiencies on HPC systems; complex multi-stage workflows challenging to optimize.
motivation: Comprehensive LRM training characterization on production HPC systems (Perlmutter) needed to guide future HPC-AI system design.
method: HPC-R1: characterization of LRM training stages (SFT, GRPO-based RL, generation, distillation) on NERSC Perlmutter; detailed performance analysis.
key_novelty: First comprehensive LRM training characterization on Top500 HPC system; 19 key observations across all training stages.
contributions: Comprehensive LRM training characterization on Perlmutter
Analysis of SFT, GRPO-based RL, generation, and distillation
19 key observations and system inefficiency identification
Recommendations for future HPC-AI system design
